Messages.Author: cofius
Messages.Body: When a referendum called by charming loby passes, then the next referendum called by that player passes or any other player as well?

Messages.Author: aXeLl
Messages.Body:
Charming Lobby, Action, Presence, U , [Jyhad:U, V:TES:U, CE:U/PTo]

+1 stealth political action.
This vampire calls a referendum listed on a political action card in your hand (play that card) or allowed by an effect in play. If the referendum passes, then the next referendum called by any vampire thereafter passes automatically.
As above, and this vampire gains 2 votes for the first referendum.

So any vampire how can reach referendum win it. Regardless of controler.
